Mumbai, India’s Financial Capital, is undergoing a $60 Billion Mega Makeover that will completely change the face of the city. From Asia’s largest slum redevelopment in Dharavi, to the Mumbai Metro expansion, to futuristic projects like the Navi Mumbai International Airport and Mumbai Coastal Road, this is the biggest transformation in India’s history.
In this video, we cover all the major upcoming megaprojects in Mumbai 2025–2035, including:
Dharavi Redevelopment Project – World’s largest urban renewal ($36B).
Mumbai Metro Expansion – 337 km, 12 corridors, $15B mega project.
